named_method: training-free task-guided cropping for fine-grained MLLM perception
definition: start from a global image view
infer or approximate task-relevant region of interest without retraining the vision encoder
crop/zoom local region to recover lost fine detail
combine local crop evidence with global context
assumptions: task-guidance can be approximated by image-derived saliency / high-frequency localization in absence of runnable MLLM
fine-detail recovery can be proxied by local sharpness, contrast, and text/edge density gains
invariants: both global and local evidence retained
comparison includes baseline versus crop-enhanced pathway
deviations: No actual MLLM loaded due missing torch/transformers and no benchmark QA annotations in workspace
Task guidance implemented as unsupervised ROI proposal rather than language-conditioned attention
